reading-the-enemy.titel: Plan your response around the enemy's intended approach
reading-the-enemy.tekst: Learn how the opponent intends to play so you can choose a better response.

reading-the-enemy.titel: Decide who can take the aggressive role
reading-the-enemy.tekst: Assess the opposing force so you can choose an aggressive or controlling role.

reading-the-enemy.titel: Do not select targets for their strength alone
reading-the-enemy.tekst: Judge a target's mobility before committing, because a powerful enemy may be better left alone.

flanks-centre.titel: Hold the centre, win a flank, then turn on the centre
flanks-centre.tekst: Hold the middle while your flank units win space they can use to support the centre or attack the backline.

flanks-centre.titel: Use expendable units to buy time for wins elsewhere
flanks-centre.tekst: Use chaff to delay the flank you expect to lose while concentrating your strength on the flank you want to win.

flanks-centre.titel: Use flank terrain to keep units out of sight
flanks-centre.tekst: Use terrain on the flanks to block enemy line of sight and protect your units.

concentration.titel: Concentrate your strength against part of the enemy army
concentration.tekst: Bring your strength against an isolated part of the enemy army so its other units cannot contribute effectively.

concentration.titel: Keep your main force close enough for support
concentration.tekst: Keep your main force in a compact area so its units can support one another.

concentration.titel: Stack buffs on the same unit
concentration.tekst: Put multiple buffs on one unit to improve its chances in a fight.

tempo-trading.titel: Use expendable units to buy time for wins elsewhere
tempo-trading.tekst: Use expendable units to disrupt and delay enemy threats while the rest of your army advances its plan.

tempo-trading.titel: Keep vulnerable units safe to preserve their points
tempo-trading.tekst: Keep vulnerable units away from dangerous enemies when saving their points helps your plan.

tempo-trading.titel: Use up a dragon's turns when you cannot beat it
tempo-trading.tekst: When you cannot beat an enemy dragon, use up its limited turns so it collects fewer points.

tempo-trading.titel: Reassign your units when the battle goes badly
tempo-trading.tekst: When your plan goes wrong, redirect your units towards jobs that can still help you recover.

threat-zones.titel: Use threats to restrict movement without committing to combat
threat-zones.tekst: Position your threats to make the opponent avoid useful areas or change their moves without needing to fight.

threat-zones.titel: Cover escape routes with overlapping charge arcs
threat-zones.tekst: Coordinate several charge arcs so mobile enemies cannot simply slip away from a single threat.

threat-zones.titel: Keep threatened units outside enemy charge reach
threat-zones.tekst: Check enemy charge reach and move threatened units beyond it to deny easy charges.

aggression-control.titel: Take risks when a passive plan cannot win
aggression-control.tekst: Accept a risky play when holding back offers no realistic route to victory.

aggression-control.titel: With the stronger shooting army, shoot first and fight later
aggression-control.tekst: Use ranged pressure to make the enemy approach while delaying combat until it suits your plan.

aggression-control.titel: Win objective contests without needing to destroy enemy units
aggression-control.tekst: Move into scoring positions and hold them, because objective points can reward survival and position without enemy kills.

aggression-control.titel: Plan which units will hold the objectives at the end
aggression-control.tekst: Plan your late movement so your units can claim the objectives when endgame scoring is decided.

aggression-control.titel: Start scoring accessible progressive objectives early
aggression-control.tekst: Get onto accessible objectives early so repeated scoring builds a lead while the opponent delays.

list-building.titel: Build your list to meet the tournament's mission requirements
list-building.tekst: Check the tournament missions when choosing units so your army has a workable plan for their requirements.

list-building.titel: Give your units and characters defined battlefield jobs
list-building.tekst: Assign your units, characters or small groups specific jobs so you can judge how they contribute to your plan.

list-building.titel: Practise with the army you will take to events
list-building.tekst: Play repeated games with your tournament list so you remember its abilities and make decisions more quickly.

list-building.titel: Avoid making your whole plan depend on one tool
list-building.tekst: Include alternatives so a failed or lost key piece does not leave you without a plan.

list-building.titel: Choose a straightforward army while learning the game
list-building.tekst: When you are learning, choose a straightforward army so it is easier to manage.

pre-game-checks.titel: Check enemy reach before choosing safe deployment positions
pre-game-checks.tekst: Check enemy movement and attack ranges before deploying so opening threats do not catch valuable units.

pre-game-checks.titel: Review the deployment zone before planning your opening
pre-game-checks.tekst: Review the deployment zone beforehand so you can plan where your army will start.

pre-game-checks.titel: Plan your deployment around the scenario's objectives
pre-game-checks.tekst: Identify the objectives before deploying so you can plan your opening around their locations.

drops-first-turn.titel: Weigh the first-turn bonus when choosing deployment drops
drops-first-turn.tekst: Consider how your deployment drops affect the first-turn bonus so you can favour going first when it matters.

drops-first-turn.titel: Delay key placements until relevant enemy units are committed
drops-first-turn.tekst: Wait for relevant enemy placements before choosing your own positions so you can use that information.

drops-first-turn.titel: Deploy defensively when preparing to go second
drops-first-turn.tekst: Use a defensive deployment when preparing to go second so your important units are protected during the opponent's opening.

unit-placement.titel: Deploy units so their planned support can work
unit-placement.tekst: Deploy units that need each other within supporting reach so they can work together as your plan unfolds.

unit-placement.titel: Guard vulnerable flanks with terrain or supporting units
unit-placement.tekst: Use terrain or supporting units to cover vulnerable flanks and prevent enemies getting around your line.

unit-placement.titel: Use threats to restrict movement without committing to combat
unit-placement.tekst: Position threats to cover enemy approaches so your opponent has fewer safe places to advance.

unit-placement.titel: Concentrate your strength against part of the enemy army
unit-placement.tekst: Concentrate your army against part of the enemy force so you can create a local advantage.

unit-placement.titel: Deploy scorers to reach the objectives you plan to contest
unit-placement.tekst: Deploy scorers with practical routes to your planned scoring areas so they do not waste turns getting into position.

deploying-vs-shooting.titel: Hide vulnerable units behind terrain to deny enemy shooting
deploying-vs-shooting.tekst: Use terrain that blocks line of sight to shelter units from damaging shooting.

deploying-vs-shooting.titel: Screen your important units from enemy shooting
deploying-vs-shooting.tekst: Deploy a screen in front of important units so enemy shooting must deal with that protection first.

deploying-vs-shooting.titel: Use terrain cover to protect units from shooting
deploying-vs-shooting.tekst: Position your units to gain cover from terrain so enemy shooting is less effective.

ambush-scouts-vanguard.titel: Use ambushers to score in unattended areas
ambush-scouts-vanguard.tekst: Send your ambushers into unattended scoring areas to claim points where the opponent has left space.

ambush-scouts-vanguard.titel: Block useful enemy ambush entry space during deployment
ambush-scouts-vanguard.tekst: Position your units near relevant board edges during deployment to restrict where enemy ambushers can enter.

ambush-scouts-vanguard.titel: Use your units to deny forward Scout deployment
ambush-scouts-vanguard.tekst: Place your units to deny enemy Scouts space near your army so they have to start farther away.

ambush-scouts-vanguard.titel: Choose protected arrival positions for your ambushers
ambush-scouts-vanguard.tekst: Bring your ambushers on in protected positions so they can contribute without unnecessary exposure.

ambush-scouts-vanguard.titel: Choose shooting ambushers for an immediate arrival volley
ambush-scouts-vanguard.tekst: Choose shooting ambushers so you can attack a target on arrival without waiting for a later charge.

charge-setup.titel: Position for reliable charges before committing your attacker
charge-setup.tekst: Close the distance before committing so your charge does not depend on a high roll.

charge-setup.titel: Check charge arcs before moving into attack position
charge-setup.tekst: Manoeuvre to threaten your intended charge without giving the enemy a favourable charge in return.

charge-setup.titel: Cover escape routes with overlapping charge arcs
charge-setup.tekst: Coordinate several charge arcs so mobile enemies cannot simply slip away from a single threat.

charge-order.titel: Order charges to preserve your important attackers' paths
charge-order.tekst: Choose charge order around where units will finish so your important attackers are not obstructed.
Check that another enemy is a legal charge target so you can redirect when your first target flees.

charge-order.titel: Make one target flee before redirecting into another
charge-order.tekst: Make a target flee with an initial charge so you can redirect into another enemy you want to fight.

wheels-alignment.titel: Keep enemy overruns and redirects away from your valuable units
wheels-alignment.tekst: Position your screen so the enemy's charge contact leaves its overrun clear of the unit you are protecting.

wheels-alignment.titel: Offset the nearest skirmisher to control charge contact
wheels-alignment.tekst: Place the nearest skirmisher off to one side so its position determines where the enemy must make contact.

wheels-alignment.titel: Plan your final facing to preserve later charge options
wheels-alignment.tekst: Plan wheels and alignment so your intended later targets are within your charge arc.

overrun-pursuit.titel: Line up overruns into another fight
overrun-pursuit.tekst: Plan overrun paths that carry your attackers into another enemy unit so they can keep fighting.

overrun-pursuit.titel: Keep enemy overruns and redirects away from your valuable units
overrun-pursuit.tekst: Arrange screens and nearby units so an enemy's overrun or pursuit cannot carry it into another valuable unit.

overrun-pursuit.titel: Reform victorious units towards their next useful fight
overrun-pursuit.tekst: Consider restraining and reforming after a win so your combat unit can threaten another useful fight.

overrun-pursuit.titel: Let another unit chase fugitives while your main unit stays useful
overrun-pursuit.tekst: Let a supporting unit chase fleeing enemies so your main combat unit can reform or stay in a useful position.

reforms-formations.titel: Use marching column to reach useful positions quickly
reforms-formations.tekst: Use marching column's extra march distance to reach objectives, blocking positions or approaches for later attacks.

reforms-formations.titel: Arrange shooting units to prevent models blocking shots
reforms-formations.tekst: Adjust your missile unit's formation so its own models do not obstruct sight to the target.

reforms-formations.titel: Use Evasive to reface on the opponent's turn
reforms-formations.tekst: Take the free reform after an Evasive retreat so your unit has a useful facing before your own turn.

fleeing.titel: Draw chargers towards waiting combat units with fleeing screens
fleeing.tekst: Position a fleeing screen so following it brings the enemy within reach of your waiting combat units.

fleeing.titel: Give fleeing bait enough clearance to escape
fleeing.tekst: Position your bait far enough away that its retreat can carry it beyond the charger's reach.

fleeing.titel: Place a receiving unit behind your planned retreat
fleeing.tekst: Retreat through a friendly unit positioned to intercept the charger instead of letting it reach your retreating piece.

support-countercharge.titel: Reinforce your main fight with flank or rear charges
support-countercharge.tekst: Bring support into the enemy's flank or rear to help your main unit win the fight.

support-countercharge.titel: Prepare countercharges with units that can survive the first charge
support-countercharge.tekst: Use a receiver that can survive a charge and keep support ready to countercharge afterwards.

support-countercharge.titel: Give supporting chargers banners for extra combat resolution
support-countercharge.tekst: Consider banners on support chargers so their extra combat resolution can help swing the fight.

support-countercharge.titel: Use bait and screens to set up your supporting charges
support-countercharge.tekst: Place bait or screens so an enemy following them comes within reach of your supporting countercharge.

choosing-chaff.titel: Choose chaff that can fill several roles
choosing-chaff.tekst: Choose versatile chaff so each unit offers several ways to support your army.

choosing-chaff.titel: Include chaff to enable your main combat units
choosing-chaff.tekst: Use chaff to obstruct enemy plans and create opportunities for your main combat units.
Keep investment in expendable chaff low because losing it is part of its job.

redirecting.titel: Use expendable units to buy time for wins elsewhere
redirecting.tekst: Use disposable blockers to waste enemy turns while your other units gain time to act.

redirecting.titel: Use bait and screens to set up your supporting charges
redirecting.tekst: Position a diverter so following or defeating it leaves the enemy exposed to your supporting units' charges.

redirecting.titel: Keep enemy overruns and redirects away from your valuable units
redirecting.tekst: Position your sacrifice so defeating it cannot carry the enemy into the unit you want to protect.

redirecting.titel: Choose mobile chaff that can reach its blocking position
redirecting.tekst: Use mobile chaff that can reach the enemy's route and obstruct its movement.

decoys-bait.titel: Use bait and screens to set up your supporting charges
decoys-bait.tekst: Offer bait where engaging it brings the enemy within reach of your supporting charges.

decoys-bait.titel: Use dangerous decoys to divert resources from your main force
decoys-bait.tekst: Offer threats the enemy cannot safely ignore so dealing with them consumes resources that could threaten your main force.

decoys-bait.titel: Bait compulsory charges at the edge of their range
decoys-bait.tekst: Place bait near maximum charge range so compulsory charges waste the enemy's time.

decoys-bait.titel: Position bait sideways to pull chargers out of position
decoys-bait.tekst: Place bait off to one side so following it forces the charger to turn out of position.

screens.titel: Screen your important units from enemy shooting
screens.tekst: Keep a screen between enemy shooters and important units so it absorbs fire, blocks shots or provides cover.

screens.titel: Clear screens from your combat units' attack routes
screens.tekst: Plan how your screen will clear the route so your combat units can make their intended attacks.

screens.titel: Screen frenzied units until you want them to charge
screens.tekst: Keep a screen in front of frenzied troops so you can position them before committing to your chosen charge.

screens.titel: Position chaff to keep overruns away from valuable units
screens.tekst: Position your chaff so an enemy overrun cannot carry straight into a valuable unit.

screens.titel: Use chaff to absorb First Charge
screens.tekst: Put expendable chaff in front of important units so the enemy spends its First Charge on the chaff.

retreat-paths.titel: Use friendly units as retreat backstops
retreat-paths.tekst: Use friendly units behind a fight so withdrawing through them leaves your unit protected behind your line.

retreat-paths.titel: Block enemy retreats towards the board edge
retreat-paths.tekst: Place models behind an enemy so withdrawing through them can carry that enemy off the board.

retreat-paths.titel: Put chaff behind enemies to cause peril tests
retreat-paths.tekst: Place chaff behind enemies you expect to flee so retreating through it causes peril tests.

clearing-chaff.titel: Use ranged attacks to clear enemy chaff
clearing-chaff.tekst: Use ranged attacks to remove enemy chaff without having to catch it in combat.

clearing-chaff.titel: Use supporting units to clear your main attackers' paths
clearing-chaff.tekst: Use another unit to clear or displace blockers so your main attacker can reach its intended target.

clearing-chaff.titel: Give skirmisher hunters enough mobility to reach their targets
clearing-chaff.tekst: Choose mobile hunters so they can reach skirmishers despite those targets' freedom to reposition.

anchors.tekst: Build your infantry anchor's combat resolution so powerful attackers struggle to beat it.

anchors.titel: Prepare countercharges with units that can survive the first charge
anchors.tekst: Use a receiver that can survive the charge so a supporting unit can countercharge.

anchors.titel: Prioritise defence over damage when building an anchor
anchors.tekst: Build your anchor to survive attacks and hold ground, treating damage output as secondary.

death-stars.titel: Give your infantry Death Star a large wound pool
death-stars.tekst: Take enough bodies and wounds for your Death Star to absorb casualties and keep fighting.

death-stars.titel: Buff your Death Star to improve its combat performance
death-stars.tekst: Use buffs on your Death Star to help it beat opposing units.

unit-builds.titel: Build infantry blocks to win through static combat resolution
unit-builds.tekst: Use ranks and banners to raise your infantry's combat result without relying entirely on inflicted wounds.

unit-builds.titel: Add characters to give basic units more combat punch
unit-builds.tekst: Add fighting characters or character buffs to increase your basic infantry's damage output.

unit-builds.titel: Use challenges to help infantry hold against dragons
unit-builds.tekst: Use a challenger while your infantry supplies combat resolution to hold or beat a dragon.

unit-builds.titel: Use armour-piercing weapons to improve infantry damage
unit-builds.tekst: Give combat infantry armour-piercing weapons to improve its damage output.

holding-combat.titel: Prepare countercharges with units that can survive the first charge
holding-combat.tekst: Use a unit that can hold the attacker until your supporting unit can countercharge.
Use blocks that can survive a monster's attacks to try to beat it through combat resolution.

holding-combat.titel: Use defensive challenges to contain dangerous attackers
holding-combat.tekst: Use a challenger to absorb a dangerous attacker's blows so the rest of your infantry can survive.

infantry-moves.titel: Consider aggressive charges with Furious Charge infantry
infantry-moves.tekst: Consider charging with Furious Charge infantry because its extra attacks compensate for losing the second rank's attacks.

infantry-moves.titel: Use marching column to reach useful positions quickly
infantry-moves.tekst: Use marching column's extra movement to get your infantry into useful forward positions faster.

infantry-moves.titel: Advance durable infantry and let the enemy charge
infantry-moves.tekst: Advance infantry that can survive the initial charge so it can take the hit and keep fighting.

hammer-basics.titel: Choose durable hammers that can keep dealing damage
hammer-basics.tekst: Choose hammers with enough durability to take hits and still deal damage.

hammer-basics.titel: Value armour piercing when choosing melee attackers
hammer-basics.tekst: Look for armour-piercing attacks so you can give your melee units useful killing power.

hammer-basics.titel: Prefer Swiftstride to help your melee units reach charges
hammer-basics.tekst: Choose Swiftstride for melee attackers so you can reach the charges you want.

heavy-cavalry.titel: Use threats to restrict movement without committing to combat
heavy-cavalry.tekst: Keep cavalry threatening a charge so you can make opponents hesitate or change their moves.

heavy-cavalry.titel: Use heavy cavalry as a mobile backup
heavy-cavalry.tekst: Use heavy cavalry as a second threat so you can bring its mobility to bear where needed.

heavy-cavalry.titel: Use heavy cavalry to support combined fights
heavy-cavalry.tekst: Use heavy cavalry alongside another unit so you can strengthen the combined fight with its charge.

chariots.titel: Set up your hammers to deliver their own charges
chariots.tekst: Plan your chariots' approach so you can get their charges and deliver their damage effectively.

chariots.titel: Reinforce your main fight with flank or rear charges
chariots.tekst: Bring a supporting chariot into an existing fight so you can help your main unit finish it.
Commit several chariots together so you can concentrate their combat damage.

monsters-dragons.tekst: Use monsters on the flanks so you can bring their stomps and combat power into the fight.

monsters-dragons.titel: Choose hammers that can survive shooting on the way in
monsters-dragons.tekst: Choose durable monsters so you can survive enemy shooting and reach combat.

monsters-dragons.titel: Counter enemy dragons with a dragon of your own
monsters-dragons.tekst: Consider bringing your own dragon so you have another way to fight an enemy dragon.

monsters-dragons.titel: Support your monster's charge with another unit
monsters-dragons.tekst: Charge another unit alongside your monster to support its attack.

monsters-dragons.titel: Use Terror to exploit weaker enemy Leadership
monsters-dragons.tekst: Use Terror where enemy Leadership is weaker so you have a better chance of making units flee.

random-movers.titel: Use random movement to deny charge reactions
random-movers.tekst: Use random movement to make contact so your target cannot use its usual charge reaction.

random-movers.titel: Use unpredictable random movement to restrict enemy positioning
random-movers.tekst: Threaten nearby ground with random movers so you can make opponents hesitate or change their positioning.

random-movers.titel: Threaten unseen targets with random movers
random-movers.tekst: Consider attacking targets behind terrain because, in the speakers' interpretation, your random mover does not need line of sight.

using-hammers.titel: Screen your hammers with chaff while setting up favourable charges
using-hammers.tekst: Use chaff or skirmishing screens so you can protect your hammer while arranging a favourable fight.

using-hammers.titel: Soften targets before your finishing cavalry charge
using-hammers.tekst: Weaken the target with shooting or an earlier cavalry attack so your finishing cavalry has a better chance of breaking through.

combat-roles.titel: Choose combat characters with all-round charge options
combat-roles.tekst: Choose characters that can threaten charges in every direction so you have more freedom to pick their fights.

combat-roles.titel: Add characters to give basic units more combat punch
combat-roles.tekst: Add fighting characters or character buffs to basic units so they become more threatening in combat.

combat-roles.titel: Threaten monsters with Monster Slayer characters
combat-roles.tekst: Use a Monster Slayer character to make enemy monsters wary of approaching.

combat-roles.titel: Use durable characters to keep enemy threats occupied
combat-roles.tekst: Use a tank character's durability to hold enemy threats in place.

bsb.titel: Keep a BSB near combats you need to hold
bsb.tekst: Keep your BSB near units that must hold so its reroll helps prevent them breaking.

bsb.titel: Keep healers within your BSB's reroll range
bsb.tekst: Keep healing characters near your BSB so they can reroll failed healing tests.

bsb.titel: Keep vulnerable support characters out of direct melee contact
bsb.tekst: Keep support characters outside combat so they can help your fighting units without being exposed to melee attacks.

mounts-items.titel: Consider chariot mounts for additional wounds and protection
mounts-items.tekst: Consider a chariot mount to give your character more wounds and improve its survivability.

mounts-items.titel: Use the Falcon Horn to restrict enemy flyers
mounts-items.tekst: Use the Falcon Horn to stop enemy flight and limit where those models can move.

mounts-items.titel: Choose combat characters with all-round charge options
mounts-items.tekst: Choose characters or mounts with all-round charge options so you can threaten targets around them.

mounts-items.titel: Choose weapons useful beyond monster hunting
mounts-items.tekst: Consider weapons effective against varied targets so your character has uses beyond killing monsters.

mounts-items.titel: Use character threats to deter enemy dragons from approaching
mounts-items.tekst: Use a character carrying the Dragon Slaying Sword to make an enemy dragon's approach risky.

challenges.titel: Use defensive challenges to contain dangerous attackers
challenges.tekst: Use a champion or protected character to absorb a dangerous attacker's blows and protect other models in the combat.

challenges.titel: Use challenges to help infantry hold against dragons
challenges.tekst: Face a dragon with a challenger so your infantry's combat resolution can help it hold or win.

challenges.titel: Keep your challenger able to reach the threatened fighting rank
challenges.tekst: Position your intended challenger in, or able to enter, the threatened fighting rank so it can issue or accept a challenge.

protecting-characters.titel: Keep lone characters near suitable troops for targeting protection
protecting-characters.tekst: Keep lone characters near suitable friendly troops to protect them from ranged targeting.

protecting-characters.titel: Use movement spells to get characters out of danger
protecting-characters.tekst: Use magical movement to rescue a threatened character or give it the mobility to withdraw after using its abilities.

protecting-characters.titel: Keep vulnerable support characters out of direct melee contact
protecting-characters.tekst: Position vulnerable support characters where expected chargers cannot contact them directly, reducing their exposure to attacks.

wizard-builds.titel: Use economical builds for the magic roles you need
wizard-builds.tekst: Choose a cheap caster or dispeller that can fulfil its intended job to limit your points investment.

wizard-builds.titel: Equip your Doppelganger caster with a useful combat weapon
wizard-builds.tekst: Consider a weapon whose bonuses improve the attacks your caster makes through Spectral Doppelganger.

wizard-builds.titel: Use several low-level casters to repeat useful signature spells
wizard-builds.tekst: Take multiple low-level casters with a useful, cheaply cast signature spell to gain repeated casting attempts.

lores-spells.titel: Secure key spells instead of relying on random generation
lores-spells.tekst: Use spell selection or useful signature spells to avoid being left with spells your plan cannot use.

lores-spells.titel: Choose spells that suit the enemy you face
lores-spells.tekst: Choose spells for the opposing army's targets and threats so your selection stays useful in that matchup.

lores-spells.titel: Choose spells that help defensive units hold
lores-spells.tekst: Choose spells that protect your defensive units so they can withstand enemy attacks.

dispelling.titel: Save limited dispelling tools for critical moments
dispelling.tekst: Keep limited dispelling tools for spells that threaten your plan when stopping them matters most.

dispelling.titel: Keep your caster beyond enemy dispel range
dispelling.tekst: Keep your caster outside the enemy wizard's dispel range to protect its spells from wizardly dispelling.

dispelling.titel: Use expendable troops to shut down enemy wizards
dispelling.tekst: Consider sacrificing troops to attack an enemy wizard when preventing its magical influence is worth the loss.

dispelling.titel: Use Spellbreaking against casts your normal dispelling struggles to stop
dispelling.tekst: Use Runes of Spellbreaking when strong enemy casting makes normal dispelling unreliable.

wizard-placement.titel: Position dispellers to cover enemy casters
wizard-placement.tekst: Position your dispellers to bring enemy casters within range so you can contest their spells.

wizard-placement.titel: Cast from outside the enemy wizard's dispel range
wizard-placement.tekst: Keep your caster outside the enemy wizard's dispel range while reaching its targets so the wizard cannot contest your casts.

wizard-placement.titel: Use skirmishing formations to reduce incoming shooting hits
wizard-placement.tekst: Put your wizard in a skirmishing bunker so its shooting hit penalty helps protect the unit.

wizard-placement.titel: Keep support casters behind the units they help
wizard-placement.tekst: Keep your supporting casters behind friendly blocks so they can contribute while staying protected.

magic-missiles.titel: Aim suitable missiles at expensive single-wound cavalry
magic-missiles.tekst: Target expensive single-wound cavalry with suitable magic missiles to remove valuable models.

magic-missiles.titel: Damage enemy scorers to deny their objective points
magic-missiles.tekst: Focus damage on enemy scoring units to stop them earning objective points.

magic-missiles.titel: Use magic missiles against enemies that evade combat
magic-missiles.tekst: Bring magic missiles to threaten mobile enemies you struggle to catch in combat.

buffs-hexes.titel: Lower enemy Leadership before Terror, break tests and Leadership attacks
buffs-hexes.tekst: Lower enemy Leadership before Terror, break tests or Leadership-based attacks to increase failures or damage.

buffs-hexes.titel: Weaken enemy armour with Plague of Rust before attacking
buffs-hexes.tekst: Cast Plague of Rust on armoured targets so your attacks face less armour protection.

buffs-hexes.titel: Protect defensive units with Earthen Ramparts
buffs-hexes.tekst: Use Earthen Ramparts on threatened missile troops so its ward save helps them survive incoming attacks.

buffs-hexes.titel: Use Battle Lust to strengthen your combat units
buffs-hexes.tekst: Use Battle Lust's Hatred and Frenzy to help your combat units win fights.

buffs-hexes.titel: Use Glittering Robe to protect against shooting
buffs-hexes.tekst: Cast Glittering Robe on units exposed to shooting to reduce the damage they suffer.

control-spells.titel: Use movement spells to accelerate your advance
control-spells.tekst: Use movement magic to push attacking units farther forward and apply pressure sooner.

control-spells.titel: Use movement spells to get characters out of danger
control-spells.tekst: Use magical movement to rescue a threatened character or give it the mobility to withdraw after using its abilities.

control-spells.titel: Use movement spells to escape enemy charge arcs
control-spells.tekst: Use movement magic to reposition threatened units outside enemy charge arcs and avoid their charges.

control-spells.titel: Place control spells across the enemy's intended route
control-spells.tekst: Place obstructing or dangerous spells across the enemy's intended route to disrupt its movement.

control-spells.titel: Use movement magic to reach Fanatic launch positions
control-spells.tekst: Reposition Night Goblin carriers with movement magic to reach useful Fanatic release positions and angles.

casting-aids.titel: Use Power Scrolls for crucial casts
casting-aids.tekst: Use a Power Scroll when a particular spell is crucial to improve your chance of getting it through.

casting-aids.titel: Keep your casting support within range
casting-aids.tekst: Keep sources of casting bonuses close enough to your casters for those bonuses to apply.

casting-aids.titel: Support demanding spells with extra casting bonuses
casting-aids.tekst: Seek casting bonuses beyond wizard level when investing in magic to make demanding spells more reliable.

war-machines.titel: Guard artillery approaches with supporting units
war-machines.tekst: Use supporting units to intercept approaching hunters so your artillery remains protected.
Use stone throwers to threaten targets behind terrain so enemies cannot escape your shooting by hiding.

war-machines.titel: Use rerolls to make artillery more reliable
war-machines.tekst: Give your artillery access to a reroll so its firing is more reliable.

war-machines.titel: Weaken dangerous enemies with shooting before your troops fight them
war-machines.tekst: Shoot approaching enemies before combat so your troops face a weakened target.

missile-units.titel: Keep your shooters beyond enemy charge reach or arcs
missile-units.tekst: Position your shooters outside enemy charge range or arcs so they can keep firing without being caught.

missile-units.titel: Weaken dangerous enemies with shooting before your troops fight them
missile-units.tekst: Shoot approaching enemies with Irondrakes so they reach combat already damaged.

missile-units.titel: Choose shooting ambushers for an immediate arrival volley
missile-units.tekst: Choose shooting ambushers so they can attack on arrival instead of waiting for a later charge.

missile-units.titel: Protect defensive units with Earthen Ramparts
missile-units.tekst: Cast Earthen Ramparts on your missile troops to gain a ward save and disrupt incoming charges.

missile-units.titel: Reposition great-bow Ushabti without losing shooting accuracy
missile-units.tekst: Move or turn your great-bow Ushabti to keep targets in their firing arc without movement penalties to shooting.

target-priority.titel: Concentrate ranged attacks to finish targets
target-priority.tekst: Focus your ranged attacks on one target at a time so you remove it instead of spreading damage.

target-priority.titel: Weaken dangerous enemies with shooting before your troops fight them
target-priority.tekst: Remove wounds or models from dangerous enemies before combat so your troops have a more manageable fight.

target-priority.titel: Remove enemy artillery early to protect your important units
target-priority.tekst: Shoot enemy artillery early so it cannot damage the units you need.

target-priority.titel: Pick off vulnerable lone wizards with screams
target-priority.tekst: Use screams against targetable lone wizards to remove enemy support.

target-priority.titel: Use volume fire against lightly armoured infantry
target-priority.tekst: Aim high-volume shooting at lightly armoured infantry to remove models effectively.

avoiding-fire.titel: Hide vulnerable units behind terrain to deny enemy shooting
avoiding-fire.tekst: Use terrain that blocks line of sight to shelter units from damaging shooting.

avoiding-fire.titel: Screen your important units from enemy shooting
avoiding-fire.tekst: Keep screening units between enemy shooters and important units to block or reduce incoming fire.

avoiding-fire.titel: Protect vulnerable scorers with cover or screens
avoiding-fire.tekst: Keep vulnerable scorers covered or screened so they survive to claim or hold objectives.

avoiding-fire.titel: Stack shooting hit penalties to protect your units
avoiding-fire.tekst: Combine shooting hit penalties on your units to reduce the effectiveness of incoming fire.

avoiding-fire.titel: Use skirmishing formations to reduce incoming shooting hits
avoiding-fire.tekst: Use a skirmishing formation when you need protection from shooting because its hit penalty makes your unit harder to hit.

evasive-skirmish.titel: Reform after evading to face where you need
evasive-skirmish.tekst: Use the free reform after an Evasive retreat to set a useful facing against the enemy.

evasive-skirmish.titel: Use Evasive to retreat beyond shooting range or sight
evasive-skirmish.tekst: Position your Evasive unit so its retreat can escape the shooter's range or sight and deny the shot.

evasive-skirmish.titel: Keep your shooters beyond enemy charge reach or arcs
evasive-skirmish.tekst: Move away from approaching enemies so your shooters stay out of combat.

terrain-los.titel: Keep friendly models out of your shooting lanes
terrain-los.tekst: Arrange or move your units so friendly models do not obstruct your shooters' line of sight.

terrain-los.titel: Use terrain to shorten enemy charges and buy time
terrain-los.tekst: Position around terrain that shortens enemy charges to buy time for shooting or movement.

terrain-los.titel: Hide vulnerable units behind terrain to deny enemy shooting
terrain-los.tekst: Use terrain that blocks line of sight to shelter units from damaging shooting.

terrain-los.titel: Use random movement to threaten unseen targets
terrain-los.tekst: Consider random-movement attacks on unseen enemies because line of sight need not prevent these moves.

hunting-shooters.titel: Reach combat early to cut a gunline's shooting time
hunting-shooters.tekst: Reach combat quickly against a gunline so its shooting has less time to damage your army.

hunting-shooters.titel: Against Cathay, send cannon hunters that can handle Ogre crews
hunting-shooters.tekst: Bring hunters strong or numerous enough to handle Ogre crews so Cathayan cannons do not defeat them.

hunting-shooters.titel: Use suitable ambushers to hunt enemy war machines
hunting-shooters.tekst: Give suitable ambushing units the job of attacking and destroying enemy war machines.

hunting-shooters.titel: Push threats forward to draw fire away from key units
hunting-shooters.tekst: Present threats to enemy artillery so the opponent spends shots on them instead of your key units.

picking-fights.titel: Aim magic missiles at valuable single-wound cavalry
picking-fights.tekst: Use magic missiles against valuable single-wound cavalry because removing those models makes the cast worthwhile.

picking-fights.titel: Choose fights you can win in the first round
picking-fights.tekst: Pick targets your attacker can beat in the first round rather than relying on it to grind through them.

picking-fights.titel: Deploy your hammers opposite targets they can beat
picking-fights.tekst: Set up favourable matchups during deployment so your hammers fight enemies they can defeat.

vs-sky-lanterns.titel: Against Cathay, use multiple-wound attacks against Sky Lanterns
vs-sky-lanterns.tekst: Use attacks that inflict multiple wounds to bring down Sky Lanterns.

vs-sky-lanterns.titel: Draw Sky Lanterns into prepared attacks with bait
vs-sky-lanterns.tekst: Use bait to draw Sky Lanterns into positions where your shooting or chargers can punish them.

vs-sky-lanterns.titel: Lower enemy Leadership before Terror, break tests and Leadership attacks
vs-sky-lanterns.tekst: Lower a Sky Lantern's Leadership before Terror tests or Leadership-based attacks to make them more effective.

vs-sky-lanterns.titel: Spread models to reduce bombing-run hits
vs-sky-lanterns.tekst: Spread your models out so a Sky Lantern's bombing run hits fewer of them.

vs-sky-lanterns.titel: Use poisoned shooting to wound Sky Lanterns
vs-sky-lanterns.tekst: Consider poisoned shooting against Sky Lanterns because it helps your shots inflict wounds.

vs-grand-cathay.titel: Against Cathay, aim Doom Divers at its big threats and artillery
vs-grand-cathay.tekst: Doom Divers can soften the Shugengan Lord before your Wyvern goes in, or thin out Cathay's artillery before its opening volley.

vs-grand-cathay.titel: Against Cathay, send cannon hunters that can handle Ogre crews
vs-grand-cathay.tekst: Send cannon hunters with enough bodies or combat power to survive and handle the Ogre crew.

vs-grand-cathay.titel: Use AP3 to remove Sky Lantern armour saves
vs-grand-cathay.tekst: Use AP3 attacks against Sky Lanterns so their armour does not stop your damage.

vs-grand-cathay.titel: Bring dispelling aids against Cathay's Plague of Rust
vs-grand-cathay.tekst: Bring dispelling aids so you can stop Cathay's Plague of Rust.

vs-grand-cathay.titel: Remove enemy artillery early to protect your important units
vs-grand-cathay.tekst: Shoot Cathay's artillery early to reduce the damage from its opening barrage.

vs-beastmen.titel: Use magic to delay the Beastmen advance
vs-beastmen.tekst: Use magic to delay approaching Beastmen and buy time for your plan.

vs-beastmen.titel: Weaken Dragon Ogres before your infantry fights them
vs-beastmen.tekst: Reduce the Dragon Ogres' fighting power before combat so your infantry can withstand them.

vs-bretonnia.titel: Against Bretonnia, use low-Strength shooting to avoid the stronger Blessing
vs-bretonnia.tekst: Use low-Strength shooting against Bretonnian knights so you avoid improving their Blessing save.

vs-bretonnia.titel: Keep your shooters beyond enemy charge reach or arcs
vs-bretonnia.tekst: Keep your Gyrocopters outside the knights' charge reach or arcs so they can shoot without being charged.

vs-bretonnia.titel: Put ranged units at the front against approaching knights
vs-bretonnia.tekst: Place ranged units at the front so approaching Bretonnian knights face shooting before combat.

vs-tomb-kings.titel: Use combined charges when one attacker lacks the damage
vs-tomb-kings.tekst: Commit several attackers together against the poison block so their combined force can overcome it.

vs-tomb-kings.titel: Reach combat before Tomb Kings cripple your attackers
vs-tomb-kings.tekst: Advance into combat promptly so the enemy does not destroy or cripple your attackers before they can fight.

vs-tomb-kings.titel: Reach Tomb Kings casters to disrupt their raising
vs-tomb-kings.tekst: Try to reach the Tomb Kings' casters so you can disrupt the return of killed models.

vs-monsters.titel: Use challenges to help infantry hold against dragons
vs-monsters.tekst: Include a challenger so your infantry can contribute combat resolution against the dragon while the challenge contains its attacks.

vs-monsters.titel: Weaken dangerous enemies with shooting before your troops fight them
vs-monsters.tekst: Remove wounds with shooting before your troops fight the monster so the coming combat is more manageable.

vs-monsters.titel: Keep dragons occupied while you score elsewhere
vs-monsters.tekst: Keep the enemy dragon occupied so the rest of your army can earn points elsewhere.

vs-monsters.titel: Use threats to restrict movement without committing to combat
vs-monsters.tekst: Position threats to make an enemy dragon avoid an area or risk approaching it.

vs-monsters.titel: Consider the Monster Hunter Tapestry for infantry blocks
vs-monsters.tekst: Consider the Monster Hunter Tapestry to help your infantry block withstand enemy monsters.

vs-other.titel: Use Dwarf shooting to cut down Nuln Outriders
vs-other.tekst: Target Nuln Outriders with Dwarf ranged units to reduce or destroy their units.

vs-other.titel: Protect your Dwarf unit with dispelling tools
vs-other.tekst: Use your dispelling tools to prevent enemy spells from compromising your Dwarf unit.

vs-other.titel: Thin Grave Guard and obstruct space for raising
vs-other.tekst: Try thinning Grave Guard with shooting and obstructing replacement ranks so fewer models return before your next attack.

scoring-units.titel: Keep fragile scorers protected from ranged fire
scoring-units.tekst: Avoid exposing fragile scorers to ranged damage so you can preserve their ability to score.

scoring-units.titel: Use cheap units to hold objectives and scoring areas
scoring-units.tekst: Assign inexpensive units to objective-holding and area-scoring jobs.

scoring-units.titel: Use fast cavalry to reach scoring positions
scoring-units.tekst: Choose mobile cavalry scorers so you can cover the board and reach scoring positions.

objectives.titel: Win objective contests without needing to destroy enemy units
objectives.tekst: Secure objective points through your position or by moving enemies away without needing to destroy their units.

objectives.titel: Start scoring accessible progressive objectives early
objectives.tekst: Move your scorers onto accessible objectives early so you can collect points during the opening turns.

objectives.titel: Deploy scorers to reach the objectives you plan to contest
objectives.tekst: Choose objectives your army can reach and deploy your scorers to claim them.

objectives.titel: Use ambushers to score in unattended areas
objectives.tekst: Bring your ambushers into available space to capture objectives left unattended.

objectives.titel: Damage enemy scorers to deny their objective points
objectives.tekst: Focus damage on enemy scoring units to stop them earning objective points.

baggage-train.titel: Use highly mobile units to reach enemy baggage
baggage-train.tekst: Bring highly mobile units so you can reach the enemy baggage train.

baggage-train.titel: Place baggage where your planned positions can secure it
baggage-train.tekst: Match your baggage placement to where your units will be so they can secure it later.

king-of-the-hill.titel: Use short retreats to retain hill control
king-of-the-hill.tekst: Use Give Ground's short retreat to keep your scorer in range after losing combat.

king-of-the-hill.titel: Use supported charges to dislodge objective defenders
king-of-the-hill.tekst: Coordinate attackers and supporting units when charging to push a defender off an objective.

scenario-plans.titel: Build your list to meet the tournament's mission requirements
scenario-plans.tekst: Check the tournament missions while building your list so your army has a workable plan for their requirements.

scenario-plans.titel: Deploy scorers to reach the objectives you plan to contest
scenario-plans.tekst: Plan your deployment around reachable scoring locations so your units can get into position.

scenario-plans.titel: Plan late moves into table quarters
scenario-plans.tekst: Plan your late moves into table quarters so you can collect their endgame points.

late-game.titel: Keep mobile scorers safe for later scoring
late-game.tekst: Protect some mobile scoring units during the opening turns, then use them to claim objectives later.

late-game.titel: Finish surviving units with late magic missiles
late-game.tekst: Use your magic missiles to finish surviving enemy units late in the game and collect their points.
